segments.text: Every morning she takes the long way round,
not because it is faster, because it is hers.
It has been dropped down a scree slope, left on a night train, and never once given up on her.
Some things you replace. Some things you keep.

content.full_text: Every morning she takes the long way round, not because it is faster, because it is hers. 11 years, one flask. It has been dropped down a scree slope, left on a night train, and never once given up on her. Some things you replace. Some things you keep. Northspur. Made to be kept.
